name: VINVEST
recent: Vinvest Capital 于2026年10月28日召开第23届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。公司于2025年11月宣布以5万令吉出售子公司 Vivocom Enterprise 全部股权，并于2025年11月14日补充相关资料。最新季度（2026年7月31日止）营收环比下降32.3%但同比增长174.7%，净亏损64.4万令吉，亏损幅度较上季收窄。
notable: 以5万令吉出售子公司 Vivocom Enterprise 的100%股权。
第23届常年股东大会于2026年10月28日举行，所有决议获股东通过。
risks: 公司触发上市条例第8.03A条，处于财务困境监测状态，需按月发布公告。
最新季度仍录得净亏损64.4万令吉。
earnings: 2026年7月31日止季度营收1122.6万令吉，环比下降32.3%，同比增长174.7%；净亏损64.4万令吉，净利率-5.7%，较上季的-16.7%有所改善。

recent_en: Vinvest Capital held its 23rd AGM on 28 October 2026, with all resolutions approved. The company announced the disposal of its entire stake in subsidiary Vivocom Enterprise for RM50,000 in November 2025, with additional information provided on 14 November 2025. For the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue fell 32.3% QoQ but rose 174.7% YoY, with a net loss of RM644,000, narrowing from the previous quarter.
notable_en: Disposed 100% equity interest in subsidiary Vivocom Enterprise for RM50,000.
Held 23rd AGM on 28 October 2026; all resolutions passed by shareholders.
risks_en: The company is under Paragraph/Rule 8.03A of the listing requirements (financially distressed), requiring monthly announcements.
The latest quarter still recorded a net loss of RM644,000.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM11.226 million, down 32.3% QoQ but up 174.7% YoY; net loss was RM644,000 with a net margin of -5.7%, improving from -16.7% in the previous quarter.
